payload.title: M5: Backfill, operate and evaluate multilingual publications
payload.description:
As a publication operator, I want to add languages to an existing corpus safely and see translation quality and spend, so rollout remains manageable.

Backfill references, concepts, stories, sections and public pages in bounded batches; prioritize live and frequently read content; make reruns safe. Show coverage, backlog age, failures, quality findings, approvals and token spend by locale and content type. Provide pause/resume, retry and glossary/policy version updates. Pilot English and Spanish on Machines on Machines, including its attribution wording and Concepts Wiki, without hard-coding that site's identity into Papyrus. Define sampled editorial evaluation for fluency, terminology, factual fidelity and accessibility before broad rollout. Account for conversations and other user-authored text as a later explicit extension with original wording preserved.

Acceptance: adding Spanish to an existing site progresses to measured coverage without duplicate items or broken links; operators can repair failures and estimate ongoing cost; the pilot demonstrates a complete reader journey and tested correction/withdrawal flow. Gherkin scenarios and focused integration tests cover backfill and recovery.
